pages: D-NP-PC-3073 Date: To: From: Subject: June 24, 2026 Internal, Sales, Distribution, and Applied Sales Representatives Sri Swaminathan, Director of Residential Controls and Solutions New Daikin Zone Control Panel for Residential Unitary Inverter Ducted Systems We are pleased to announce the new Daikin Zone Control Panel (DOZP-6-ADA-A), designed for residential unitary inverter ducted systems using Daikin ONE+ (DTST-CWBSA-NI-A, DTST-CWBSA-NI-B) or Daikin ONE Touch (DTST-TOU-A) smart thermostats. The new Daikin Zone Control Panel (DOZP-6-ADA-A) transforms a traditional single-thermostat HVAC system into a true zonal comfort solution, supporting up to six independently controlled zones. Designed to work with residential unitary R-32 communicating inverter ducted systems (Daikin FIT), it intelligently manages airflow and system capacity across multiple zones to deliver consistent comfort, quiet operation, and high efficiency throughout the home. By matching unit’s heating or cooling output to meet real zone demand, the Daikin Zone Control Panel is designed to help resolve common hot- and cold-room issues in both single- and multi-story homes. The system combines fully modulating dampers (field provided), wireless temperature and humidity sensors (DSEN-TH-BWS-A), and inverter-specific control logic with cloud connectivity through the SkyportCare platform. Commissioning, monitoring, and long-term service are supported through SkyportCare, providing visibility into zone operation, airflow, static pressure, and system behavior. This integrated approach helps support humidity and temperature control. Requires thermostat software version 4.0.10 or newer for DTST-CWBSA-NI-A, DTST-CWBSA-NI-B and DTST-TOU-A. Product Offering To help simplify ordering and installation, a Daikin Zone Control Panel (DOZP-6-ADA-A), is available for bundling the required core components, including the Zone Panel as the primary system controller and a Differential Pressure Sensor. Key Benefits Compared to No Zoning • Independently control comfort in up to six zones to meet the needs of different rooms, floors, and family members • Modulated system capacity and airflow with inverter-specific logic to reduce temperature swings and support improved humidity control • Included Differential Pressure Sensor (required) provides operational advantages that can help eliminate the requirement for bypass dampers typically required during low load periods • Auto-sizing and zone weight validation to help identify and verify zone sizing and ductwork during commissioning • Fully modulating dampers will help provide with Quiet operation, air management and static pressure management. • Outstanding energy efficiency by delivering heating or cooling only to active zones and avoiding over-conditioning • Wireless room humidity and temperature (DSEN-TH-BWS-A) sensors help eliminate the need to run new thermostat wiring and allow for flexible placement and zoning design • Zone-level alerts for damper failures, communication loss, and airflow issues to help protect equipment and comfort • Integrated A2L alarm interface, UL-listed zone board, and organized wire routing to help simplify installation • Built-in AUX terminals to support humidity control, AUX heat source, and future enhancements without rewiring App Integration • SkyportHome (homeowners) app: Complete comfort control • SkyportCare (dealers) app: Commissioning, remote control, and monitoring, including visibility into zone demands, damper status, static pressure, and alerts Warranty Complete warranty is available from your local dealer or at www.daikincomfort.com.
